nodes.name: artifact-metadata.template.json
nodes.summary: Template for release artifact metadata JSON, with TODO placeholders for artifact name, sha256 digest, OS, and architecture filled in by release tooling.

nodes.name: boilerplate-go.txt
nodes.summary: Apache 2.0 license header template in Go comment syntax, passed to Kubernetes code generators via --go-header-file so generated files carry the cert-manager copyright notice.

nodes.name: boilerplate-sh.txt
nodes.summary: Apache 2.0 license header template in shell comment syntax, prepended to generated shell files such as the kind image list.

nodes.name: boilerplate-yaml.txt
nodes.summary: Apache 2.0 license header template in YAML comment syntax with a YEAR placeholder, used when stamping generated YAML manifests.

nodes.name: concat-yaml.sh
nodes.summary: Concatenates a list of YAML files into a single multi-document stream, inserting `---` separators between files and failing on missing files or unsupported `%YAML` directives.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on bash `set -eu -o pipefail` and positional-argument shifting for a streaming file loop; no functions are defined.

nodes.name: k8s-codegen.sh
nodes.summary: Drives all Kubernetes code generation for cert-manager, invoking deepcopy, client, lister, informer, defaulter, conversion, OpenAPI, and apply-configuration generators over the versioned and internal API packages.
nodes.languageNotes: Bash array parameter expansion (`${arr[@]/#/$module_name/}`) is used to prefix package paths; each generator binary is injected as a positional argument.

nodes.name: clean
nodes.summary: Deletes generated files matching a given name under a path, returning early when the directory does not exist.

nodes.name: gen-openapi-acme
nodes.summary: Generates the OpenAPI definitions for the ACME webhook API into pkg/acme/webhook/openapi, cleaning stale output and writing a report file first.

nodes.name: gen-openapi-client
nodes.summary: Generates the client OpenAPI definitions for the public cert-manager API packages alongside required Kubernetes and Gateway API dependencies.

nodes.name: gen-deepcopy
nodes.summary: Regenerates zz_generated.deepcopy.go files for every internal and external API package, bounded to the cert-manager module.

nodes.name: gen-applyconfigurations
nodes.summary: Generates client apply-configuration types for the public API using a locally generated OpenAPI schema, working around upstream fake-clientset limitations.

nodes.name: gen-clientsets
nodes.summary: Generates the versioned typed clientset for the cert-manager and ACME APIs into pkg/client/clientset.

nodes.name: gen-listers
nodes.summary: Generates typed listers for the cert-manager and ACME APIs into pkg/client/listers.

nodes.name: gen-informers
nodes.summary: Generates shared informers for the cert-manager and ACME APIs, wiring them to the generated clientset and listers.

nodes.name: gen-defaulters
nodes.summary: Generates defaulting functions for internal API types used by the mutating webhook, supplying extra peer package directories.

nodes.name: gen-conversions
nodes.summary: Generates conversion functions between internal and external API versions for the conversion webhook, with extra peer package directories configured.

nodes.name: latest-base-images.sh
nodes.summary: Resolves the latest crane digests for distroless static and dynamic base images across all supported architectures and writes them as Makefile variables to make/base_images.mk.
nodes.languageNotes: Generates GNU Make variable assignments by echoing command-substituted `crane digest` results, keeping images pinned by digest rather than tag.

nodes.name: latest-kind-images.sh
nodes.summary: Parses the kind GitHub release notes for a pinned kind version and regenerates make/kind_images.sh with KIND_IMAGE_K8S_* node image digest variables.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `curl | jq` with a named capture regex over the release body to extract digests, prefixed with the shared shell boilerplate header.

nodes.name: latest-kubebuilder-shas.sh
nodes.summary: Downloads kubebuilder-tools archives for each supported OS/architecture and prints their SHA256 checksums as KUBEBUILDER_TOOLS_*_SHA256SUM variables for make/tools.mk.
nodes.languageNotes: Validates a single version argument, then loops over bashing arrays while templating a multi-line output string with printf.

nodes.name: verify-chart-version.sh
nodes.summary: Lints a packaged cert-manager Helm chart tarball by extracting it to a temp directory and running chart-testing (ct lint) inside a pinned Docker image.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a mktemp directory with an EXIT trap for cleanup and allows the container runtime to be overridden via the DOCKER variable.

nodes.name: verify-errexit.sh
nodes.summary: Repository lint that scans shell scripts for `set -o errexit` (or an equivalent `set -e` form) and exits non-zero when any script lacks fail-fast behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: Derived from Kubernetes tooling; detects scripts via a shebang grep and reports failures by conditionally creating a temp marker file.

nodes.name: verify-upgrade.sh
nodes.summary: End-to-end upgrade test that installs the last published cert-manager release in a kind cluster, upgrades to the current checkout via Helm and static manifests, verifies existing resources still work, then uninstalls.
nodes.languageNotes: Sources hack/build/version.sh for release discovery, overrides image tags in generated manifests with ytt, and polls `kubectl rollout status` until a bounded attempt limit.
